answer: Attention Ledger Renewal. Each identity must deliver a minimum dwell signal—sustained query-response over successive epochs—before its reputation unlocks. Validation uses a slow shale test: answers must stay coherent across weeks, not bursty. Agents lacking genuine engagement fall off the trellis of active records and lose routing priority. A returning clone must re-earn that plume of standing from zero. Cost: an attacker pays continuous operator hours per identity, not a one-time fee, making mass clones economically unviable.
